title: Camera Object-Detection Counts by Type
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=frigate:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as detections by label camera _time
| stats sum(detections) as total by label camera
| sort - total
description: Summarises how many people, cars, and animals each camera detected so you understand the normal traffic around your home.
value: A baseline of detections per camera turns object detection from a stream of clips into a picture of your property's routine.
implementation: Send NVR detection events to `index=personal`; schedule daily and review counts by object type and camera.
visualization: Bar chart of detections by object type per camera.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many people, cars, and animals each camera sees, so you learn what is normal around your home.
